Name: Fix Android Photo Upload Crash
Description: Marcus is assigned to fix the photo upload crash on Android 14 that occurs when the app is backgrounded mid-upload. The crash is due to a NullPointerException in the media picker callback. The task needs to be fixed and verified by Wednesday so QA can test it before the mobile release on August 20th.

Name: Verify Fix on Android 14 Test Devices
Description: Sam will confirm the fix for the Android crash on Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it. This should be added to the regression run to ensure the issue is resolved before the release.

Name: Develop Offline Mode for Notes List
Description: Elena will build the backend sync API for offline mode, which includes sending the last-synced timestamp and getting a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Marcus will handle the client side, implementing a local cache in Room and queuing writes while offline to replay when connectivity returns. Acceptance criteria include functioning offline mode with no data loss upon reconnection.

Name: Migrate Jenkins Pipelines to GitHub Actions
Description: Sam will migrate the existing Jenkins pipelines to GitHub Actions, starting with the test and release pipelines. The migration will include maintaining the nightly build schedule and running both systems in parallel for a week before decommissioning Jenkins, ensuring stability and continuity.

Name: Implement Per-User Rate Limiting on Search Endpoint
Description: Elena will add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint to prevent degradation from misbehaving scripts. The limit will be set to 100 requests per minute per user, with an HTTP 429 response and a Retry-After header for excess requests. A metrics counter will also be added to monitor usage.

Name: Update Privacy Policy Screen for GDPR Compliance
Description: Marcus will update the privacy policy screen to ensure GDPR compliance for the EU launch. The new screen will feature separate opt-in toggles for analytics and marketing, replacing the single pre-checked box. This update is a critical requirement for the August 20 release.

Name: Write Automated Tests for Payments Flow
Description: Sam will create regression tests for the payments flow, covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and receipt validation paths. These tests will be integrated into the new GitHub Actions pipeline to prevent issues similar to those in the last release.
